description: Sorts an Umbraco package's NuGet and npm dependencies into locked to the CMS, shipped to sites, and dev-only, and says what each kind needs: which version, how sibling packages pin each other, and Dependabot rules. Use when adding, bumping or importing a dependency (including writing client code that imports Lit, UUI or RxJS), referencing a sibling package, judging an update PR, writing dependabot.yml, or matching dependencies to a new CMS version.
